scientific_question: Can the accepted StructMem revision be reduced to the exact LightMemory runtime chain and official event prompts without copying unrelated methods, experiments, tests, or results?
decision_informed: Whether StructMem can enter isolated dependency and lifecycle gates from a minimal source-authoritative copy.
scientific_evidence_role: engineering source-copy gate only; no import, dependency, model, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim

copy_scope.authority: Git-tracked files at the frozen source revision only
copy_scope.excluded: EM2Mem, FluxMem, memory_toolkits, evaluation scripts, published results, figures, notebooks, web and MCP code, tests, Git metadata, untracked files, bytecode, symlinks, model files, and all other repository paths

execution_contract.wave1_non_interference: This small source-only copy may run while Wave1 is active because it performs no network access, dependency installation, model download, model load, API call, service start, or GPU operation.

acceptance: The accepted source checkout resolves to the exact frozen revision and is clean.
Only selected Git-tracked regular files are copied.
The destination and evidence roots were absent before execution.
The result contains exactly 66 files and 344766 bytes.
The root MIT LICENSE is retained while the pyproject metadata discrepancy remains disclosed.
No copied relative path contains __pycache__ and no copied file ends in .pyc.
Every copied file has a retained relative path, byte size, and SHA-256.
The evidence root has TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, no TERMINAL_REJECTED, and a verified evidence inventory.
failure: Any collision, source identity mismatch, dirty source, non-regular selected file, cardinality mismatch, copy error, license omission, bytecode inclusion, or timeout seals a fresh TERMINAL_REJECTED root and retains the partial destination.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit and locally archive the execution copy, then freeze exact dependencies and LLMLingua model files. This stage never authorizes import or lifecycle execution.
prohibited_actions: editing the accepted official source checkout
copying other method families, published results, tests, bytecode, symlinks, or model files
installing dependencies, downloading models, calling an LLM, opening Qdrant, or using a GPU
starting a lifecycle or numerical run
deleting or repairing a rejected destination in place
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from this gate
